title: Bubble Bobble
build: Remember's crack of the disk version ("cracked in August 2002", +12 trainers, all left off), the one file BUBBLE BOBBLE+ of a T64 archive; the game starts at $4460

tools.emulator: VICE via vice-mcp: release v3.13.2, v3.13.2-macos-arm64-gui.dmg (x64sc, PAL; host sound device set to dummy)

exclude: the table of multiples of eight, built by the start-up; zero as loaded
the second character set, built at run time; as loaded it holds the cracker's copy of $0400-$07FF and zeros
the first screen buffer; as loaded it holds the text and the first part of the cracker's trainer menu, which the game's first screen clear wipes
the second screen buffer; as loaded it holds the rest of the cracker's trainer menu code
sprite buffers built at run time (mirrored boss, food and bonus sprites); zero as loaded
the collision map, its wrap rows and the actor arrays kept in its spare columns; zero as loaded
the tail of the clean screen copy; zero as loaded
include: level layouts in the RAM under the I/O area, read with $01 = $30
